# PRFlow Documentation

Use this documentation to install PRFlow, learn its core workflows, choose where runs execute, configure the plugin and resolve common problems.

The documentation is organized around user goals:

- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started/index) provides the shortest path to a first pull request.
- [Workflows](/docs/workflows/index) explains what PRFlow can do.
- [Runs](/docs/runs/index) explains local and cloud execution.
- [Configuration](/docs/configuration/index) covers the settings you can change.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting/index) provides symptom-based recovery guidance.

If you are new to PRFlow, begin with [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation), then complete your [First run](/docs/getting-started/first-run).
